Brilliant staff and atmosphere
Mar 2026 • Couples
This is the best bar in HCMC. The band is brilliant. Atmosphere electric, every night of the week. But the best recommendation is for the staff. My husband lost his backpack with all his cards, mobile phone and a pile of cash. We went back the next night hoping to get the cards/drivers license back. Staff had found his backpack. Still had all contents in it. Including the money. Blow away with their honesty. Yes, we gave them a tip. But honestly, they were genuinely shocked to receive it. We will leave HCMC with lasting memories of this experience. Thank you guys so much 🙏🙏🙏

Do not believe “Happy hour”!
Nov 2022 • Couples
Today we had drinks at Lost in Saigon. They told us there was “Happy hour”, it was also stated on the sign outside. “Buy 2 get 1 free” from 19.00 PM to 21.00 PM. And this is not extraordinary as we have experienced this more often during our trip in Vietnam. Drinks are a bit more pricey but during “Happy hour” you get a fairly good deal.

What a surprise it was when we got the bill… from the 6 drinks we had only 1 was for free.. I tried to get an explanation several times but then suddenly no one can understand English..

Never coming back, they do not really care but I just would like to warn you because in the end we paid full price for 5 drinks (and the drinks were far more expensive than in other places). BEWARE fellow travelers!
